info.title: Bitrix24 REST API
info.description: Bitrix24 REST API provides access to CRM, tasks, drive, chats, telephony, e-commerce, automation, and other modules. Documentation: https://apidocs.bitrix24.com

post.summary: Set Up an Event Handler for the Interface BX24.placement.bindEvent
post.description: The method `BX24.placement.bindEvent` sets an event handler for the interface. The event must be registered on the calling side; otherwise, nothing will happen.

event.description: | The name of the event to which the handler subscribes ||
| The name of the event to which the handler subscribes ||

post.summary: Call the Registered Interface Command BX24.placement.call
post.description: The method `BX24.placement.call` invokes a registered interface command.

post.summary: Get Information About the JS Interface of the Current Placement BX24.placement.getInterface
post.description: The method `BX24.placement.getInterface` allows you to retrieve information about the JS interface of the current placement: a list of available commands and events.

post.summary: Get Information About the Call Context of BX24.placement.info
post.description: The method `BX24.placement.info` retrieves information about the context of the embedding handler call. No parameters.

post.summary: Register a new event handler event.bind
post.description: The method `event.bind` registers a new event handler. The method works only in the context of [application](../../settings/app-installation/index.md) authorization. It can operate both under a user with portal administration rights and under a regular user. The method for a user without administrator rights is available with limitations: 1. Offline events are not available; attempting to set them will raise an exception. 2. Events are set on behalf of the current user (see the description of the `auth_type` parameter). Explicitly specifying an `auth_type` different from the `ID` of the current user will also raise an exception.

auth_type.description: | User ID under which the event handler is authorized. By default, the authorization of the user whose actions triggered the event will be used ||

event_type.description: | Values: `online\|offline`. By default, `event_type=online`, and the method's behavior does not change. If `event_type=offline` is called, the method works with offline events ||

auth_connector.description: | Source key. This parameter is intended for offline events. It allows excluding false event triggers ||

options.description: | Additional settings for the registered event, if any ||

post.summary: Mark a Block as Undeleted with landing.landing.markundeletedblock

post.summary: Set Up the Widget Handler placement.bind
post.description: The method `placement.bind` adds a handler for the widget placement. It can be called at any time during the application's operation; however, it is often more convenient to register your widgets during the [application installation](../../settings/app-installation/index.md). It is important to note that until the application installation is complete, the widgets you register will not be available to regular users in the Bitrix24 interface—they will only be visible to users with administrative rights. [Check the application installation](../../settings/app-installation/installation-finish.md).

DESCRIPTION.description: | Description of the widget in the interface. Not used in practice ||

GROUP_NAME.description: | Allows grouping UI elements for multiple handlers of the same widget type. For example, several dropdown items in the top button of the CRM card. Supported only by certain types of widgets ||

OPTIONS.description: | Additional display parameters for the widget. Specific values depend on the widget placement location. Currently used in widgets for messengers, in the widget `PAGE_BACKGROUND_WORKER`, and in the widget CRM_XXX_DETAIL_ACTIVITY

USER_ID.description: | Identifier of the Bitrix24 user for whom the registered widget will be available. Possible values can be obtained using the user.get method.

post.summary: Download the voting report vote.AttachedVote.download
post.description: The method `vote.AttachedVote.download` generates and provides a downloadable report for the vote in the specified format. Attention! This method is an exception to the general rule of working with the REST API. Unlike other methods, it returns not a `JSON` object, but the actual content of the file with HTTP headers that initiate the download in the browser. Due to this, the standard function `BX24.callMethod()` **cannot** process the response and will throw an error. To work with this method, a direct HTTP request must be made, as shown in the JS code example.
